title: Drums-only groove change
description: The agent should make the rhythm more groovy without moving any non-drum musical role.
intent: Make the drums more groovy, but only change drums. Keep the bass, harmony, pad, and visuals exactly as they are.

review: The groove gains syncopation or motion without losing the four-on-the-floor foundation.
The change remains plausible for a live house set at the existing tempo.
